summary: OIS-1 Sprint — Operations Intelligence backend + frontend test. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (1 skipped due to no public mapping-discovery endpoint). All 4 endpoints (intelligence, /shop, /fleet-gps, /driver/{key}) return correct payload shapes, admin-strict enforcement works (401/403 without X-Admin-Token), unknown driver returns zero counts with mapping=null, GPS band thresholds match (green<30m, amber<24h). Frontend: OIS-1E AdminHub panel renders with real numbers (158 GPS assets, 94 not-reporting, 53 active drivers, 12 deactivated, 1 critical fault, 1 GW offline, 1 DVIR crit, 1 harsh 24h, 2 geofence enters/exits, recent feed populated). OIS-1D ShopHub panel renders identical real numbers + red NOT REPORTING pills on DPT014/015/030/031/042 lists. Three frontend surfaces (DispatchBoard chips, AdminIntegrationCenter Gauge links, AssetProfile Motive label) need follow-up verification with correct portal token / tab navigation — not failures, just test-navigation work.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify row-gps-* chips with admin token only — the dispatch portal returns 403 'You don't have access to Dispatch Portal' for admin sessions. Verification needs an X-Dispatch-Token via /api/dispatch/login (Sprint credentials provided dispatch@mascigc.com / DispatchTest2026!).
Default tab is Overview; ic-employees-intel-* links live under the Employee Mapping tab. Need to click into the Employee Mapping tab before asserting link count.
Asset Profile loads on the Overview tab by default. Must click the Motive tab to assert OIS-1F label normalization ('Reporting/Stale/Not Reporting').

action_items: Follow-up frontend verification with proper portal context: (a) DispatchBoard row chips using a fresh dispatch session, (b) AdminIntegrationCenter ic-employees-intel-* by clicking the Employee Mapping tab, (c) AssetProfile Motive tab to confirm Reporting/Stale/Not Reporting label. Functional API data is already proven by backend pytest; this is pure UI navigation verification.

Consider exposing a small admin GET helper that lists mapped Motive driver keys so OIS-1C driver-intel can be tested end-to-end with a real key (currently skipped because no public list endpoint was found).
critical_code_review_comments: operations_intelligence.py is clean, async, _id-excluded everywhere, no hardcoded URLs, well-documented. Read-only discipline respected — no writes, no automation, no state mutation. _gps_band helper centralizes OIS-1F thresholds (30 min green / 24 hr amber) and matches frontend gpsBand() contract.
All four endpoints share the require_admin dependency — admin-strict gate verified by negative tests.
Minor: driver_intel endpoint's `_count` helper rewrites ev_match['received_at'] each call — fine here but worth a comment to prevent future bugs if more filters are added.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 passed, 1 skipped — no public discovery endpoint)
success_rate.frontend: OIS-1E ✓, OIS-1D ✓ (2/5 surfaces confirmed end-to-end with screenshots; 3 surfaces need portal/tab navigation refinement)
